recipe.title: Cumin-spiced lamb leg with chopped Greek salad
recipe.notes: This recipe is from Fatima's, via My Food Bag.
recipe.prep: Preheat oven to 200 deg C fan bake.

i.n: wholemeal pita breads, cut into wedges

method.s: Pat lamb dry. Combine first measure of garlic, oil, cumin seeds and mustard in a bowl. Add lamb and toss to coat. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat a frying pan on medium-high heat. Cook lamb fat-side down for 3 minutes. Flip and cook a further 2 minutes.
Transfer to a lined oved tray and bake for 10-14 minutes for medium.

Cut pita bread into wedges and toss on lined oven tray with second measure of garlic, oil and sesame za'atar. Season with salt. Toast in the oven below the lamb for about 8 minutes, until golden. Set aside.
Combine vinegar, sumac and second measure of mustard in a salad bowl with a pinch of salt. Toss in all the salad ingredients.
Just before serving, toss pita bread through salad. Thinly slice lamb.
Divide salad between plates and serve with lamb. Dollop with tzatziki.
